title: Optimization and validation of a consolidated Set of TaqMan qPCR assays for the surveillance of clinically relevant antibiotic resistance genes in environmental matrices
author: Rathinavelu, Beck, et al.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from clinical strains
steps.instruction: In a BSL‑II laboratory, pick a few colonies of each reference strain grown on sheep blood agar plates (positive and negative controls) and extract genomic DNA in duplicate using the QIAmp® DNA Mini Kit (Qiagen, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s instructions; store the purified DNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Collect duplicate wastewater grab samples
steps.instruction: Collect duplicate 5 L grab samples of treated effluent from the two wastewater treatment plants (ARA Falkenstein and STEP‑Ville de Lausanne) in sterile sampling bottles, keep the bottles in the dark at 4 °C during transport, and process the samples within 24 h of collection.

steps.title: Filter‑concentrate wastewater biomass
steps.instruction: Pass each 5 L sample through a sterile 0.22 µm, 47 mm cellulose‑ester S‑Pak filter (Merck, Germany) until the filter pores are clogged, thereby concentrating the biomass.

steps.title: Store filters and extract DNA
steps.instruction: Store the clogged filters at –80 °C until DNA extraction. Then extract DNA from each filter using the DNeasy PowerWater Kit (Qiagen, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol; store the resulting DNA extracts at –20 °C.

steps.title: Thaw DNA extracts on ice
steps.instruction: Prior to downstream analysis, thaw all frozen DNA extracts (both from isolates and wastewater) on ice.

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity and concentration
steps.instruction: Evaluate the extracted DNA by (i) running an aliquot on an agarose gel to check integrity, (ii) measuring 260/280 and 260/230 absorbance ratios with a NanoDrop One Spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA), and (iii) quantifying DNA concentration with a Qubit™ 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) using the Qubit™ dsDNA BR Assay Kit, following the kit’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Run agarose gel electrophoresis to assess DNA integrity.
Measure 260/280 and 260/230 ratios on NanoDrop One.
Quantify DNA with Qubit 4 using dsDNA BR Assay Kit.
